purpose: Code-model batch: conversions, benchmarks, and failure causes (2026-11-20)

results.note: measured via direct TokenizedInputs generation (counted tokens: 32/32, interval 0.755s). The gpu_characterize harness fails on this IR with infer_request.cpp:224 (input-signature quirk in the harness path) while plain LLMPipeline string and TokenizedInputs generation both work — harness-only issue, model fine. A string-prompt run showed ~244 tok/s which was a prompt-caching artifact; the counted-token number (40) is authoritative and fits the fleet scaling curve.

results.model: StarCoder2-7B (converted: optimum 2.3.0 + transformers 4.57.1, INT4, stateful; tokenizer/detokenizer IRs via openvino-tokenizers)
results.note: conversion required transformers >=4.57 (conflicts with DS-Coder's <=4.53.3 requirement — different models need different venv pins). optimum's convert_tokenizer=True did NOT emit OV tokenizer IRs; the standalone openvino-tokenizers package (convert_tokenizer with with_detokenizer=True, unpacking the returned tuple) produced them.

results.cause: optimum export fails tracing sanity checks (TracingCheckError) on the model's custom MoE code (trust_remote_code=True required and accepted, but torch.jit tracing rejects the custom architecture). Also requires transformers <=4.53.3. Not convertible with the current optimum toolchain; recorded as a negative result.

results.model: Qwen3-Embedding-4B (converted INT4 + tokenizer IRs copied from the 0.6B official sibling)
results.note: validated via GenAI TextEmbeddingPipeline on CPU. optimum's convert_tokenizer=True did not emit openvino_tokenizer.xml here either; copied from the 0.6B official IR (same Qwen3 tokenizer family).

results.model: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (converted from ungated NousResearch mirror; INT4, stateful)
results.note: meta-llama repo is manually gated (403 file access even with token); the NousResearch mirror carries identical weights ungated. Same tokenizer-IR fix as StarCoder2 (openvino-tokenizers package).

lessons: optimum's convert_tokenizer=True does not emit OV tokenizer IRs in this version — use the openvino-tokenizers package or copy from an official sibling
transformers version requirements conflict across models (DS-Coder <=4.53.3 vs StarCoder2 >=4.57) — per-model venv pins needed
string-prompt benchmarking can hit KV-cache/prompt-caching artifacts — always count generated tokens via EncodedResults
